faq.q: What is a titanium ball valve stem?
faq.a: A titanium ball valve stem is a precision-machined valve component component used in ball valve stem (grade 5) for chemical valve. Manufactured from Grade 2 CP-Ti for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What pressure rating for titanium ball valve stem?
faq.a: Pressure rating depends on grade, wall thickness, and temperature. Grade 2 CP-Ti pipe fittings are typically rated to Class 150 (285 psi) or Class 300 (740 psi) per ASME B16.5/B16.9. Higher ratings available with Grade 5.

faq.q: How is titanium ball valve stem manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium Ball Valve Stem is manufactured using Seamless tube extrusion. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium ball valve stem?
faq.a: The most common issue is crevice corrosion at seat interface in stagnant chemical service. Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.
